notes:
Product team (3 engs + 1 PM) building VS Code extension used by ~800 internal devs. Primary ask: streaming inline completions (character-level / low-latency token streaming) and deterministic model pinning per workspace. 
- Need: sub-50ms per-token tail latency for local network (NA), burst to 200 qps during sprint demos.
- Auth: SSO/SAML required; per-user rate limits; support for API keys for CI bots.
- Security: must pass SOC2 + audit log export to their SIEM; KMS integration for key rotation; data residency option for EU customers.
- Features asked: model variant routing (fast quantized fallback), automatic rollback on quality regression, token-level cost telemetry in console, per-workspace model pin support, ephemeral KV cache for completions.
- Quotes: "We need streaming that feels instant inside the editor — cursor-level latency is critical." — Eng Lead.
- Current stack: Electron-based VS Code extension with local proxy that enforces rate limits; they want Redwood to replace proxy and provide native rate-limit hooks and per-user quotas.
- POC constraints: must be able to toggle streaming->non-streaming, pin model to 1.7B q4 quantized, observe perf delta in Redwood Console.
- Risk: procurement pushing for on-prem option if SOC2 artifacts not produced within 3 weeks.
- Commercial: indicated preference for annual Dedicated commit if perf meets SLA.
